# Version 4.152.2 (Unreleased)
> **M152 engine fixes**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.2 incorporates upstream m152 fixes for buffer uploads and Ganesh flushes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Buffer upload handling corrected** — Adopts the Chrome m152 buffer upload fix in the bundled Skia renderer. ([#5117](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5117))
- **Ganesh flush fixes adopted** — Includes the upstream Chrome m152 fixes for the Ganesh GPU flush path. ([#5069](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5069))
